Home Rector COMSATS MESSAGE FROM THE RECTOR Message by the Rector Welcome to COMSATS University Islamabad (CUI)—a forward-looking, multi-campus public university shaping the future of education, research, and innovation in Pakistan and beyond. As Rector of this distinguished institution, spanning seven campuses across the country, it is both an honour and a responsibility to lead a university where knowledge transcends boundaries and potential is transformed into impact. CUI stands at the intersection of academic excellence, technological advancement, and societal responsibility. At COMSATS University Islamabad, we are committed to cultivating an ecosystem that champions creativity, critical inquiry, interdisciplinary thinking, and lifelong learning. Our academic rigor is purposefully aligned with the development of ethical, socially responsible, and globally competitive individuals—graduates who not only excel professionally but also contribute meaningfully to society. As you explore our digital presence, you will encounter the breadth and depth of CUI’s diverse academic programs, cutting-edge research initiatives, industry linkages, and a vibrant campus life set within our lush green environments. Whether you are a prospective student, an academic collaborator, an industry partner, or a visitor seeking insight into our vision, we invite you to engage deeply and discover the distinctive COMSATS experience. CUI is more than an institution of higher learning; it is a dynamic community of scholars, innovators, researchers, and professionals united by a shared mission—to generate knowledge, advance technology, and address real-world challenges. Our pursuit of excellence extends far beyond classrooms and laboratories, embedding resilience, leadership, and adaptability in everything we do. In response to the evolving demands of the Fifth Industrial Revolution, COMSATS University Islamabad emphasizes human-centric, sustainable, and ethically grounded education that integrates advanced technologies with societal needs. Our academic and research programs equip graduates with future-ready skills, adaptability, and leadership capacity, enabling them to collaborate effectively with intelligent technologies while addressing complex economic, environmental, and social challenges. Through this approach, CUI prepares its graduates to compete globally and contribute responsibly to inclusive and sustainable development. To our students, faculty, and staff: I encourage you to embrace ambition, curiosity, and collaboration. Every member of the CUI community plays a vital role in shaping our collective future. Our faculty, administration, and support systems remain fully committed to enabling your academic, professional, and personal growth. I am confident that you will be inspired by the achievements, distinguished faculty, research output, and world-class infrastructure of COMSATS University Islamabad. Your engagement and feedback are invaluable as we continue to refine our mission of developing true professionals and global leaders in thought and action. Thank you for choosing COMSATS University Islamabad as your partner in education, research, and innovation. Together, let us shape a future driven by knowledge, excellence, and a shared commitment to national and global progress. I pray to Almighty Allah for guidance and success in our collective endeavours and look forward to even greater achievements in the years ahead. Prof. Dr. Raheel Qamar, T.I., Rector Rector's Profile RECTOR Prof. Dr. Raheel Qamar, T.I., RECTOR'S OFFICE Rector Office Functions By

Rector's Office AUTHORITY & RESPONSIBILITIES Powers & Functions of the Rector The Rector exercises the following powers and functions as provided under the applicable University provisions. 01 The Rector can direct teachers, officers and other employees of the Institute to take up such assignments in connection with teaching, research examination, administration and such other activities in the institute, as he may consider necessary for the purposes of the institute. 02 The Rector can sanction budgeted amounts for the specified purposes. 03 The Rector can re-appropriate budgetary amounts for unforeseen items not provided for in the budget. 04 The Rector can make appointments of such categories of employees of the Institute and in such manner as may be prescribed by Statutes. 05 The Rector can suspend, punish and remove, in accordance with prescribed procedure, from service officers, teachers and other employees of the Institute. 06 The Rector can delegate, subject to such conditions as may be prescribed, any of his powers to an officer or officers of the Institute. 07 The Rector can exercise and perform such other powers and functions, as may be prescribed including powers and functions incidental or ancillary to the powers and functions specified here. Home About Human Resource Department COMSATS UNIVERSITY ISLAMABAD Human Resource Department The Human Resource Department at the Principal Seat coordinates human resource planning, recruitment, personnel administration, performance management, compensation and career development, and HR policy and governance across the University. People & Institutional Development Supporting employees and organizational needs Human Resource Planning, Recruitment & Selection Assess workforce requirements across the Principal Seat and Campuses. Coordinate merit-based recruitment and selection processes. Ensure uniform implementation of recruitment policies. Provide secretarial support to the Selection Board. Process IPFP cases in coordination with HEC and Campuses. Personnel Administration Manage personnel matters of the Principal Seat and provide HR guidance to Campuses. Administer TTS faculty matters. Process leave, transfers, postings, and resignations. Handle disciplinary, grievance, and court-related matters. Provide secretarial support to statutory and administrative committees. Performance Management Coordinate employee annual performance appraisal and contract review processes. Process matters relating to performance evaluations, increments, honoraria, and contract renewals. Compensation, Benefits & Career Development Process retirement and post-service benefits. Prepare seniority lists and promotion cases. Coordinate employee training and professional development programs. HR Policy & Governance Develop and implement HR policies and procedures. Ensure consistent application of HR policies across the Principal Seat and Campuses. Provide HR advisory support to the University administration.
